_comment: Copy to D:\Dekirai\Servers\DW4Online\config\appsettings.Production.json (outside the app folder, readable only by Administrators, SYSTEM and NT SERVICE\DW4Online). It holds secrets: never commit it.
_comment_kestrel: Https: the public endpoint. If another program holds port 443 (Traefik, IIS, Apache), use another port, for example https://0.0.0.0:8443, with install-service.ps1 -HttpsPort 8443 (DEPLOY.md section 4.1). Http: appsettings.json's plain endpoint stays active below this file; it listens on the loopback address only (checks on the server: curl.exe http://127.0.0.1:5280/health). Give it another free 127.0.0.1 port if 5280 is taken (DEPLOY.md section 4).
_comment_tls: IP phase: the self-signed certificate of deploy/new-selfsigned-cert.ps1 for the IP address (the client pins it). Later add the domain to AdditionalHostNames and set Service:PathBase (DEPLOY.md section 6).
_comment_database: User ID=dw4online with its own password (DEPLOY.md section 2), or User ID=root with the root password in the root-only variant (section 2.1). Port: the database's port (3306, or 3307 next to another MySQL). AutoMigrate: the service applies pending migrations at its start too; run 'DW4Online.Server.exe migrate' in a console first anyway (DEPLOY.md, Migrations).
_comment_rooms: The room story while the owner is away: drop (the default: not saved), hold (kept until the owner returns) or apply (saved at once). DEPLOY.md section 10.
